args: Go to http://127.0.0.1:4790/login. Sign in with username {{amber_user}} and password {{amber_password}} with Stay logged in ticked, then verify the home page greets Amber Demo. summary:
Signed in as Amber Demo with the stay-logged-in option selected.
Opened the Kitchen renovation project, marked the “Choose worktop” task as done, and switched to its Kanban view.
